confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Cusco's tourist-facing price levels in July, the high season. Restaurant anchors are moderately confident; accommodation and cocktail/wine anchors are less certain and vary a lot by street, season, and property. No live listings or menus were checked. The FX observation came from RBA exchange-rate search results for 2026-10-15, not a full page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Peru's other major tourist-facing cities, with Cusco's altitude-city and Sacred Valley tourism premium reflected in accommodation and tourist-area dining. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge of bar pricing is weaker.
